snippet.title: I optimized my game (in more ways than one) | Metro Gravity Devlog 4
snippet.description:
Wishlist Metro Gravity!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2986450/Metro_Gravity/ 

Join the discord!
https://discord.gg/RM5hktBqrv 

Other socials: https://linktr.ee/mrkogamedev

In this devlog, I tell the story of how I failed (and then succeeded) at optimizing my indie game. I then proceed to show off a little bit of progress, which arose from my newfound motivation.

0:00 - Intro
0:37 - Tiny combat update
1:38 - Non-Combat feedback
2:10 - Optimization (Kind of)
3:22 - Solution attempt 1
5:47 - Solution attempt 2
6:14 - The gamedev highway
7:39 - Progress
8:05 - Outro
